contract.document_name.rationale: The title and preamble name it Service Agreement; the annex also refers to it by that name.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The date is an unfilled [Date] placeholder.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Effective as of the date above, which is an unfilled [Date] placeholder.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Only a five-year term is stated; the start date is a placeholder, so no expiration date is given.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 12 is headed Governing Law but only provides for BAC arbitration; no governing law is named.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section 13 renews automatically for another five (5) years; c2 is the initial term.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Renewal is prevented by written confirmation of termination; no notice period is stated.
